description: Figure 1: geometric calcium-site signature (tightest 5-carboxylate cluster) in B9 domains vs Ca2+-dependent and Ca2+-independent C2 domains
code:
import requests, os, numpy as np, json, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S="/tmp/b9/str/"; os.makedirs(S,exist_ok=True)
def dl(u,p):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=120); open(p,"w").write(r.text); return r.status_code
def parse_pdb(path, model=1):
    out=[];cur=1
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith("MODEL"): cur=int(line.split()[1])
        if cur!=model: continue
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
            except ValueError: continue
            out.append(dict(rec=line[:6].strip(),name=line[12:16].strip(),alt=line[16],resn=line[17:20].strip(),
                            chain=line[21],resi=int(line[22:26]),xyz=xyz,bfac=float(line[60:66] or 0)))
    return [a for a in out if a["alt"] in (" ","A")]
CARB={"ASP":"CG","GLU":"CD"}
def best_cluster(cxs,k=5):
    pts=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in cxs]); D=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-pts[None],axis=-1)
    best=(1e9,None,None)
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        idx=np.argsort(D[i])[:k]; sub=pts[idx]; c=sub.mean(0); rad=float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(sub-c,axis=1)))
        if rad<best[0]: best=(rad,[f"{cxs[j]['resn']}{cxs[j]['resi']}" for j in idx], float(D[np.ix_(idx,idx)].max()))
    return best
def carbox(atoms,chain="A",lo=None,hi=None,pl=None):
    o=[]
    for a in atoms:
        if a["rec"]!="ATOM" or a["chain"]!=chain: continue
        if lo and not(lo<=a["resi"]<=hi): continue
        if a["resn"] in CARB and a["name"]==CARB[a["resn"]]:
            if pl is not None and a["bfac"]<pl: continue
            o.append(a)
    return o

for p,l in {"1DSY":"PKCA_C2","1RSY":"SYT1_C2A_apo","1D5R":"PTEN_C2","1BYN":"SYT1_C2A_Ca"}.items():
    dl(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb", S+f"{l}_{p}.pdb")
for acc,n in {"Q21191":"MKSR1","Q9UPM9":"B9D1h","Q9N423":"MKSR2","Q9BPU9":"B9D2h","Q9NXB0":"MKS1h"}.items():
    dl(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb", S+f"AF_{n}.pdb")

CASES=[("Syt1 C2A (1BYN, Ca-bound)",S+"SYT1_C2A_Ca_1BYN.pdb",140,265,None,"Ca2+-dependent C2"),
 ("Syt1 C2A (1RSY, apo)",S+"SYT1_C2A_apo_1RSY.pdb",140,265,None,"Ca2+-dependent C2"),
 ("PKCalpha C2 (1DSY, Ca-bound)",S+"PKCA_C2_1DSY.pdb",155,293,None,"Ca2+-dependent C2"),
 ("PTEN C2 (1D5R)",S+"PTEN_C2_1D5R.pdb",186,351,None,"Ca2+-independent C2"),
 ("MKSR-1/B9D1 worm (AF)",S+"AF_MKSR1.pdb",7,203,70,"B9 domain"),
 ("B9D1 human (AF)",S+"AF_B9D1h.pdb",4,182,70,"B9 domain"),
 ("MKSR-2/B9D2 worm (AF)",S+"AF_MKSR2.pdb",2,175,70,"B9 domain"),
 ("B9D2 human (AF)",S+"AF_B9D2h.pdb",2,175,70,"B9 domain"),
 ("MKS1 human B9 (AF)",S+"AF_MKS1h.pdb",311,493,70,"B9 domain")]
labs=[];rads=[];grp=[];clus=[]
for lbl,path,lo,hi,pl,g in CASES:
    cx=carbox(parse_pdb(path),"A",lo,hi,pl); r5,res,dmax=best_cluster(cx,5)
    labs.append(lbl); rads.append(r5); grp.append(g); clus.append(",".join(res))
    print(f"{lbl:32s} r5={r5:5.2f} A   {','.join(res)}")

col={"Ca2+-dependent C2":"#2d6a9f","Ca2+-independent C2":"#9a9a9a","B9 domain":"#c0532a"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
y=np.arange(len(labs))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,rads,color=[col[g] for g in grp],height=0.65)
for yi,r in zip(y,rads): ax.text(r+0.2,yi,f"{r:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(6.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.text(6.6,len(labs)-1.2,"upper bound of real\nCa$^{2+}$-site clusters",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("radius of tightest 5-carboxylate cluster (Å)")
ax.set_title("No C2-type calcium site in B9 domains: tightest cluster of five Asp/Glu carboxylates",fontsize=11)
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=c) for c in col.values()]
ax.legend(h,col.keys(),fontsize=8.5,loc="lower right"); ax.set_xlim(0,19)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump(list(zip(labs,rads,grp,clus)),open("/tmp/b9_fig1.json","w"))
